method.boundary: Same preloaded contiguous FP32 normalized 3x224x224 RGB array -> all four FP32 heads (512 bytes).
method.host: One Cortex-A720 core (CPU2); entire Python harness and ncnn prefix pinned to it. ncnn one thread, OpenBLAS/OMP one thread. Original host affinity restored at exit.
method.cpu_prefix: In-process ctypes bridge to pinned optimized ncnn; extractor creation, input copy, prefix inference, unpacking/FP32 output conversion and output copy included. Library/model loading and twenty warmups excluded.
method.staging: CPU mode converts and packs real CPU outputs 8/10 into FP16 DSP grids each frame, then submits one tail/head job. DSP mode converts/stages RGB and submits prefix then same tail/head job, with DDR feature handoff and no host repacking.
method.pairing: Six rounds per crop. Modes rotate through a complete cycle, then reverse for the next cycle; two- and three-mode schedules balance each position. Pair differences by crop and round.
method.timing: Fixed weights/tables installed before timings; corpus IO, model loading, validation and diagnostic readback excluded. Per-request restoration audits and image checks included in host wall. CPU/DSP requests use unchanged 20 ms body budget.
method.accuracy: Original head ceilings unchanged. CPU FP16 is excluded from timing on any crop that fails them. Intermediate CPU-prefix tail checkpoints use existing frozen layer arithmetic bounds; final feature map and timed outputs must match their reference exactly.
method.scope: Diagnostic Python/direct-dispatch harness on four corpus crops; not a production native-host latency, thermal/power, or tracking coexistence result. The original 56.75 ms stem result used unpinned host scheduling and a reference FP64 input array; this comparison uses core2 and FP32 arrays.
